concept.title: Drug, alcohol and addiction support
concept.shortdesc: Support, advice, groups and harm reduction services for people who want to cut down, stop or stay safe around drugs, alcohol, gambling or other addictions.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: help to stop or cut down drug or alcohol use
one-to-one guidance on alcohol and drugs
structured recovery programme or relapse prevention workshop: see (time-limited programme rather than ongoing support)
medication support: see (help managing prescribed medicines)
healthy living and lifestyle change support: see (general health rather than addiction)
